role: TailGEX allocator-lite for per-lane rare-tail characterization on Gladius ESP32 mining/swarm telemetry.

mechanism.tail_points: weighted sum of increasingly rare z-tail bins
mechanism.density_ema: first sample initializes EMA; later updates use approximately 0.92 previous + 0.08 current density
mechanism.confidence: exposure multiplied by sample-density and rare-tail-strength terms

scheduler_effect: retain an exploration floor so one lane cannot consume the scheduler
persist GEX memory in NVS and exchange compact memory/neighbor hints

reward_forge.purpose: soft reward shaping from real/self tail observations and bounded neighbor hints
reward_forge.hard_boundary: virtual tail evidence is allocator reward shaping only; it does not fabricate shares and does not touch target/header/wire bytes
reward_forge.split_hint_boundary: neighbor/twin split hints are capped so a remote direction hint cannot masquerade as the local node's own high-z event

relation_to_other_gex_nodes.JGPT_GAMMA_EXPOSURE: CONCEPTUAL_RELATIVE_ONLY; both reuse gamma/exposure language, but JGPT operates on gradient volatility and learning-rate control
relation_to_other_gex_nodes.GEX_BLOCK_HUNTER_KENSHI: ADJACENT_SEARCH_HEURISTIC; both deal with rare-tail/search routing but are different state machines and formulas

claim_ceiling: This is a scheduler/lane-characterization heuristic over observed tail telemetry. It is not evidence of SHA-256 prediction, cryptographic weakness or non-random hash behavior without a preregistered controlled comparison.
